title: Miss Your Old House, Turn Its COLORS 🏠
description:
If you miss your old house in our town, you turn its colors, and you never see it on yourself. Mr. Pratt next door missed his houseboat. He's teal now.

We moved across town in June, and Mom keeps saying it isn't home yet. Our old house was sky blue with yellow stripes, so every morning I check her hands.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Was Mom ever homesick, or was 'it isn't home yet' about Leo all along?
